title: max_iob = 0 after upgrading to AAPS 3.1.0? Maybe due to new objectives questions?
symptom: After upgrading to AAPS 3.1.0, new objectives questions appeared, and the restriction to max_iob = 0 seems to apply. Even after answering the questions correctly, max_iob remains 0 under the loop tab.
cause: The issue was caused by misconfiguration: the Loop APS mode was set to LGS instead of Closed Loop, which enforces max_iob = 0.
fix: Change the Loop APS mode setting from LGS to Closed Loop in the settings.
evidence_quote: And in the settings about Loop APS mode, I found the setting to change it from LGS to Closed Loop and - et voîla - objective 7 is green
